name: Carlisle Bay Fun Tours and Cruises
summary: A glass bottom boat operator in Carlisle Bay, St. Michael. The main trip is a 75 minute tour to swim with sea turtles and snorkel over the bay's shipwrecks, and the boat can be chartered for up to three hours with three swim stops and a beach stop. Bookings are requested through a form on the website and confirmed by the team.
standouts: Snorkel with sea turtles and over shipwrecks in Carlisle Bay
Lifejackets, snorkel equipment and light refreshments provided

trips.title: Fun Tour
trips.summary: A 75 minute glass bottom boat trip in Carlisle Bay to swim with sea turtles and snorkel over the shipwrecks. Lifejackets, snorkel equipment and light refreshments are provided.
trips.checkNotes: Site names it 'Fun Tour!'. Departure times are the time choices on the booking request form (9:00 am, 11:00 am, 1:00 pm, 3:00 pm), not stated on the tour card. Booking is a request form; 'a member of our team will confirm your Booking'. No online payment seen. Child age range not stated.

trips.title: Chartered Tour
trips.summary: A private glass bottom boat charter of up to three hours, with swimming and snorkelling at three different spots and a beach stop. Suited to family days and company outings.
highlights: Swim and snorkel at three locations
trips.checkNotes: Tour card spells it 'Charted Tour'; the booking form says 'Chartered Tour!'. Card says '3 Hours' and 'up to 3-hour'; minimum hours and group size not stated. Per-boat hourly price, so priceFrom left null. Departure times are the booking form's time choices.
